What We Treat

Comprehensive pest solutions, residential & commercial

Our goal is to provide services that our customers would trust with their families — safe, dependable pest treatments with a reputation for honest, effective, hassle-free service.

General Pest Control

Roaches, ants, spiders, and the everyday invaders that drive homeowners crazy — treated inside and out, with flexible one-time or recurring plans.

Termite Control

Termites work silently inside your walls. We find them, eliminate them, and protect your home from the next colony before it starts.

Rodent & Animal Removal

From mice and rats to trapping and removing live animals — we get them out and help keep them out, so the problem doesn’t come back.

Residential & Commercial

Pest-free living for homes and businesses alike. Quarterly, monthly, semi-annual, or annual service — always contract-free, always on your schedule.

About Mike’s

The trusted name in League City pest control

Mike’s Pest Control tackles everything from roaches, ants, and termites to trapping and removing live animals. Our comprehensive services ensure a pest-free environment for both residential and commercial properties.

We offer flexible, contract-free plans — in addition to quarterly services, we offer one-time, monthly, semi-annual, and annual pest control. We’re dedicated to taking care of your pest management needs while eliminating the hassle of binding contracts with stiff termination fees.

  • Over 40 years of experience in the League City area
  • Safe and dependable treatments, trusted with families
  • Licensed & insured — professional service, every visit
